review_evidence: Reviewed the 124-primary-file ConstructiveLogicCourseGame source rather than relying on its stale template README. The game contains 105 source-level `Statement` proof obligations across propositional logic, quantifiers, functions and elementary arithmetic.

Representative retained statements include conjunction associativity `(A ∧ B) ∧ C ↔ A ∧ (B ∧ C)`, quantifier exercises, and natural-number multiplication identities, each accompanied by Lean proof terms through the lean4game DSL.
The custom `Statement` command explains why a plain theorem/lemma declaration grep undercounts the project; the level files are formal theorem/proof content and remain primary prior art.
summary: Reviewed the complete constructive-logic game; 105 lean4game Statement proof obligations constitute substantive formal logic and arithmetic content, so the unit is retained.
